incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: MosaicHealth - embed-check 'response_error_rate' crossed 5% for 5m. Paging eng-oncall -> Leo
Leo: ack. I'm on it, grabbing logs & dashboard link
Diane: customers seeing 502s? Support getting multiple tickets from MosaicHealth
Leo: looking at logs — 502s are coming from our edge -> error spikes correlate with tenant traffic bursts, looks like healthcheck flapping from their internal retries
Jamal: can we silence paging for that tenant while we investigate? it's paging repeatedly every 2m
Priya: agree. We should use tenant-specific suppression not global silence
ops-bot: Creating 30m silence for alert:service:response_error_rate - scope:tenant=MosaicHealth
ops-bot: silence created (id: SILE-7591) for 30m :white_check_mark:
Leo: OK thanks. I'm going to add a short-term alert tweak: increase threshold to 8% for tenant MosaicHealth and add 10m debounce
Sasha: please add a dashboard panel for per-tenant error rate distribution so we can see if other tenants are affected
Leo: creating quick dashboard now -> https://grafana.internal/r/5A7m/mosaic-error-rate
Marta: on the longer term we should implement a dedicated tenant healthcheck filter in the alert rule to reduce noise
Priya: suggest this PromQL adjustment for per-tenant rule — add namespace label and use max_over_time for debounce
Priya: ```
# example Prometheus alert snippet
expr: |
  max_over_time(
    (sum by (tenant) (rate(http_errors_total{job="edge",tenant=~".+"}[1m]))
    / sum by (tenant) (rate(http_requests_total{job="edge",tenant=~".+"}[1m])))
    [10m:1m]) > 0.08
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High error rate for tenant {{ $labels.tenant }}"
```
Leo: that looks good. I'm going to patch the alert for MosaicHealth only (temporary) with the new thresholds
ops-bot: Applied alert patch to AlertGroup 'tenant-error-rate' (patch id: AP-8823)
ops-bot: Created a tenant-scoped rule override: tenant=MosaicHealth threshold=0.08 debounce=10m
Jamal: Nice. Also recommend we add a suppress rule to ignore errors coming from the 'mosaic-internal-retry' path
Sasha: added a panel to the dashboard that shows 5xx by path -> helps identify retry loop
Diane: letting MosaicHealth support know: "We're seeing retries from your healthchecks causing transient 502s; we've throttled pager noise and are investigating. Will follow up with root cause." :phone:
product-bot: Noting potential SLA alert churn for MosaicHealth — flagging for post-incident review
Leo: temporary mitigation in place, silenced noisy pages, updated rule. Current customer impact: intermittent 502s but falling. No broader tenant impact detected.
Marta: runbook items — (1) Add tenant-specific filter to alert rule, (2) Create runbook section for 'healthcheck retry loops', (3) add automated knob to set per-tenant debounce and threshold
Priya: leaving detailed PR notes to change alerting infra — assign to eng-platform
Jamal: can someone create a small postmortem thread after we un-silence to capture follow-ups? I can draft
Leo: will hand off to Sasha for follow-up analysis in ~20m. I'm handing on-call to Sasha at 2181237890 — please escalate to me if anything regresses. :handshake:
Sasha: ack, taking on-call. moving remaining items to #eng-sre follow-up and creating ticket INF-4321 for alert rule hardening
Diane: closing customer update loop: MosaicHealth support acknowledged, will validate their internal retries
incident-bot: Incident resolved: no wider impact detected, monitoring for 1h
Leo: thanks team — please add any additional action items below. :thumbsup:
